commentary.text: 121' That's the end because the winner of this match has been decided following the penalty shootout.
121' Goal! Hossam Abdelmaguid (Egypt) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mathew Ryan into left side of the goal.
121' Lucas Herrington (Australia) misses the penalty as he smashes the ball against the crossbar!
121' Mohamed Salah (Egypt) smartly converts the penalty. He strikes the ball into the middle of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
121' Goal! Awer Mabil (Australia) sends the keeper the wrong way and scores into the bottom left corner.
121' Rami Rabia (Egypt) steps up to take the penalty and leaves the keeper helpless with a low shot inside the left post.
121' GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Jackson Irvine (Australia) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Oufa Shobeir no chance!
121' GOAL! Mahmoud Saber (Egypt) sends the penalty kick into the left of the net.
121' Harry Souttar (Australia) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well over the crossbar.
121' The penalty shootout is about to start.
120+2' Although Gustavo Tejera has now ended extra time, we still don't know who the winner is. A penalty shoot-out will decide this match.
